prompt: A lean human wizard in cerulean and deep sapphire robes with silver-thread sigils, standing in a braced side profile facing south-west, one bare palm thrust forward. An incoming crimson fireball spell hurled at him unravels and dissolves against his palm into pale blue wisps, the red fire visibly fizzling out and turning to fading cerulean motes that spiral up his arm and make his body glow brighter. The only source of light is the cold blue glow of the dying spell. The background is a dim arched stone wizard hall with tall windows.
